g.text: GovAllocXAI: Explainable Machine Learning Benchmark for Predicting
Functional Government Expenditure Shares from Official Multi-Country Data
A Multi-Country Decision-Support Framework for Public Financial Management, Fiscal Governance & Sustainable Resource Allocation
🏛️ Official Harmonized Data (Eurostat · OECD · IMF · World Bank)
⚖️ Dual Formulations: Annual Nowcast vs. Cold-Start Allocation
Public Financial Management, Medium-Term Budgeting & Explainable AI
REAL-WORLD CHALLENGE: INCREMENTAL INERTIA IN PUBLIC EXPENDITURE
Sovereign governments allocate trillions in public revenue across competing socio-economic functions (health,
education, social protection, economic infrastructure). In actual fiscal practice, budgeting is strictly incremental:
last year's split is carried forward with marginal adjustments, ignoring cross-country peer regularities and macro shifts.
Question: How much can machine learning
genuinely add over inertia using same-year indicators?
Question: What can comparable peer economies
and explanations tell an analyst when no history exists?
RELEVANCE TO COMMERCE, MANAGEMENT & LEGAL GOVERNANCE
• Public Financial Management (PFM): Empirically anchors Medium-Term Expenditure Frameworks (MTEF).
• Fiscal Governance & Anti-Corruption: Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI: Government Effectiveness,
Regulatory Quality, Corruption Control) directly link administrative competence to public resource outturns.
• Legal Accountability & AI Compliance: Public sector AI demands explainability, strict conservation laws
(sum = 100%), and human-in-the-loop oversight to satisfy non-arbitrariness and emerging AI governance statutes.
Decision Philosophy: "The tool provides an advisory reference point; it never replaces accountable human judgment."
Curate an Open, Provenance-Flagged Multi-Country Benchmark Dataset
Harmonize general-government expenditure shares across 217 economies from Eurostat, OECD, IMF GFS, and
World Bank (2000–2024). Enforce strict zero-imputation policy on all target columns with full provenance tags.
Establish Methodologically Honest Compositional Benchmark Protocols
Evaluate realistic practitioner baselines (persistence, peer group mean) across temporal, leave-country-out,
and leave-region-out splits using Total-Variation Distance (TVD), cluster bootstrap, and Holm correction.
Develop Constrained Simplex Allocation Models with Conformal Uncertainty
Implement GBDT ensembles (XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM) and NNLS stacking with exact bisection projection
guaranteeing budget closure (Σ=100%) and split-conformal 80% error intervals with applicability filtering.
Validate Explainable AI (XAI) & Deploy Decision-Support Application
Statistically test SHAP and LIME agreement, feature deletion faithfulness, and stability. Deliver an interactive
decision-support platform providing Sankey budget flows, peer benchmarking, stress testing, and UN SDG mapping.
Harmonized General-Government Expenditure by Function across 217 Economies
RIGOROUS DATA QUALITY POLICY & PROVENANCE CONTROLS
• Executed Outturns, Not Proposals: Reflects actual audited government expenditures, eliminating political proposal noise.
• Zero Imputation on Targets: Target expenditure shares are published official figures and are NEVER imputed.
• Transductive Feature Flags: 25 macro-fiscal indicators; ≤3-yr bounded interpolation with explicit per-cell flags (imp_*).
• Cross-Source Validation: Eurostat vs. OECD cross-checked on 690 overlapping rows; median discrepancy = 0.025 pp.
🔍 4. FORENSIC AUDIT OF LEGACY BENCHMARK (RESEARCH INTEGRITY)
Why Earlier R² > 0.99 Claims Were Artefacts of Synthetic Target Leakage
DISCOVERY OF TARGET LEAKAGE & EXACT FIXED MULTIPLES IN LEGACY BENCHMARK
A forensic re-audit revealed that the legacy v1 dataset's headline score (R² > 0.99, "95.29% accuracy") was completely
artificial: 11 of 15 sector targets were exact fixed linear multiples of one latent series (CV = 2.8%, k × GDP).
• Artifact Disproven: A single-parameter formula (k × GDP) scored R² = 0.9997 vs. 0.9991 for XGBoost on those sectors.
• Methodological Flaw Fixed: The legacy code ran a random train/test split, leaking neighbouring years of identical countries.
• Commitment to Truth: Rather than hiding the audit, we preserved the old dataset as a negative control and rebuilt
the entire benchmark exclusively on genuine multi-country official statistics (GovAlloc-COFOG v1.0).
Outcome: Replaced inflated synthetic metrics with transparent, verifiable scientific evidence suitable for academic peer review.
End-to-End Pipeline: Ingestion → Dual Modeling → Simplex Projection → XAI
Automated Harmonization of Official Multi-Country Statistical Sources
Extract Eurostat COFOG, OECD Table 11, IMF GFS, and World Bank WDI/WGI.
Leakage Prevention, Compositional Scaling & Provenance Flagging
25 macro features (≤3-yr interpolation flagged). Centered log-ratio (CLR) & simplex shares (% of budget).
ŷt = yt-1 + f(xt, yt-1) → Baseline: Persistence (yt-1). Tests incremental budget drift.
Mode 2: Cold-Start (NNLS Stacking & k-NN Peer Aggregation)
ŷt = f(xt) without historical allocations. Stacks XGBoost, CatBoost, Ridge & k-NN (k=8).
Solve min ||a - ŷ||² s.t. Σ a_i = 100% and l ≤ a ≤ u. Exact machine precision match with SLSQP (3.6e-15).
Empirical 80% coverage intervals; Mahalanobis applicability score flags atypical, high-risk economies.
Quantitative XAI Validation (SHAP & LIME Agreement + Deletion Faithfulness)
Evaluate sign consensus, feature rankings, and synthetic ground truth to audit interpretability claims.
Technical Blueprint: Data Layer → Allocation Engine → Human Oversight
Result: Zero fiscal budget leak; sums strictly to 100%.
weights (w_i ≥ 0, Σ w_i = 1) fitted via nested CV.
• Blends linear ridge stability with GBDT flexibility.
The system does not mandate budget figures. It operates as an analyst co-pilot: (1) Baseline Reference Split,
(2) Uncertainty Intervals, (3) Model Applicability Warning, (4) Top Macro Factor Explanations, (5) Human Approval.
Total-Variation Distance (TVD) Benchmark Across Learners & Protocols
Panel A16 (36 Economies): Stack TVD = 10.53 pp vs. Peer = 11.34 pp (gain 0.81 pp does NOT survive Holm correction, p = 0.060).
CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC TAKEAWAY FOR PUBLIC MANAGEMENT
ML cannot easily beat persistence where history exists; its true power is in Cold-Start peer benchmarking
Traceable, Verified Statistics with 95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
Δ-Hybrid TVD 3.48 vs 3.62 pp (significant in only 1 of 5 seeds)
Unseen economies (Panel B) vs. Peer Mean 0.31 & 0.25
High-Income vs Low-Income cold-start error (data scarcity)
Socio-Demographic Spending is Highly Systematic; Geopolitical Spending Resists Macro Modeling.
Health, Education, and R&D follow structural demographic paths, whereas Defence reflects independent security doctrine.
Testing Explanations Statistically: Agreement, Stability & Faithfulness
EMPIRICAL LESSON: EXPLANATIONS AGREE ON DIRECTION, NOT RANKING
• High Qualitative Consensus: 85% sign agreement demonstrates that TreeSHAP and LIME identify the same macroeconomic
drivers as increasing or decreasing public allocations (e.g. GDP per capita, Population 65+, Governance Effectiveness).
• Cautionary Guardrail: Feature ranking disagreement (ρ = 0.59) proves that analysts must not over-interpret precise decimal
attributions. Explanations reflect empirical macro associations, not causal policy levers.
Operational Implementation: React 18 · FastAPI · Budget Explorer · What-If Engine
CORE OPERATIONAL CAPABILITIES FOR FISCAL BUDGET ANALYSTS
• Interactive Budget Flow (Sankey): Maps total national fiscal envelope → 16 COFOG functional shares → UN SDGs.
• Peer Benchmarking: Instant visual comparisons against the 8 most similar socio-economic peer economies.
• Macroeconomic What-If Stress-Testing: Real-time sensitivity simulation (recession, stagflation, debt shocks).
• Conformal Uncertainty & Applicability Guardrail: Displays 80% error bars and warns if an economy is out-of-distribution.
Commerce, Management & Law Alignment · Ethical Governance · Future Roadmap
ALIGNMENT WITH COMMERCE, MANAGEMENT & LEGAL FRAMEWORKS
• Administrative Law & Non-Arbitrariness: Public finance laws require that allocation decisions be reasoned, documented,
and traceable. Our XAI layer and exact simplex constraints ensure computational reproducibility without black-box drift.
• Public Sector Management (PFM): Medium-term fiscal projections gain an objective peer reference baseline, reducing
subjective ministerial bargaining and political allocation distortions during fiscal crises.
High-Risk AI Governance: Adheres to emerging public administration standards (conformal bounds, error bounds, human veto).
• Coverage Concentration: Official COFOG data is
concentrated in Europe and OECD; only 3 low-income
• Nowcast vs. Forecast: Annual update uses realized
same-year indicators; true forecasting requires lags.
• SHAP/LIME reflect associations, not causal laws.
• Global South Expansion: Automated ingestion of
unstructured national budget gazettes and audit
• Controlled user study with professional budget analysts.
CORE CONCLUSION: LAST YEAR'S ALLOCATION IS A FORMIDABLE BASELINE;
PEERS EMPOWER COLD-START POLICY DESIGN WHEN RIGOROUSLY CONSTRAINED & EXPLAINED.
AAVISHKAR UNIVERSITY-LEVEL RESEARCH COMPETITION 2026–27 · CATEGORY: COMMERCE, MANAGEMENT & LAW · RESEARCH CODE ALLOTTED AT VENUE
